summary: The rust monster reaches an iron-bars square that C has admitted through mon.c:mfndpos's ALLOW_BARS rule, but the JavaScript simple-action preflight rejected the destination before monmove.c:postmov could execute its AD_RUST bar-dissolving branch. The baseline matched 440 screens/cursors and 3000 RNG calls, then stopped at segment 0 step 440 on key l with UnsupportedTurnBoundaryError: mfndpos() door or special terrain movement. The correction adds IRONBARS to the preflight's already-selected destination set without changing mfndpos eligibility. The corrected replay matches all 545 screens/cursors and 3084 RNG calls; admitted-range verification matches through segment 0 step 544.

fix.description: Allow an IRONBARS destination after the existing mfndpos candidate filter and test the hostile rust-monster path through preflight and postmov.

source.branch: mon.c:mfndpos admits IRONBARS only when ALLOW_BARS is set and the bar-specific attack/diggability conditions pass. monmove.c:postmov then checks the monster's actual destination; an eligible AD_RUST, AD_CORR, or metallivorous monster emits the C message, calls dissolve_bars, and returns MMOVE_DONE.

evidence: The v68 manifest identifies the source path as mon.c mfndpos ALLOW_BARS -> monmove.c postmov IRONBARS AD_RUST -> dissolve_bars. Its case recipe builds bars on an actual floor, places a hostile rust monster, transforms it to a cave spider to cross the barrier, then restores the rust-monster form so the NPC reaches the bars.

The admitted v68 evaluation's saved comparison has C totals of 545 screens/cursors and 3084 RNG calls versus JavaScript's 440 screens/cursors and 3000 RNG calls. The first missing C screen and RNG call are at segment 0 step 440, key l; C's next RNG call is rn2(5)=2 from distfleeck(monmove.c:538).

Upstream mon.c:2109 sets ALLOW_BARS for the relevant passes-bars condition; mon.c:2226 applies the bar-specific mfndpos filter. js/mon.js:2136 and js/monmove.js:1449 already port those respective decisions.

Upstream monmove.c:1624-1632 handles an IRONBARS destination. For an eligible rust/corrosive/metallivorous monster and diggable bars, it prints the eats-through-bars message, calls dissolve_bars, and returns MMOVE_DONE. js/monmove.js already implements that behavior and dissolve_bars.

In js/unported_monster_actions.js:1013-1023, admitSimpleDestinationAndRegion accepts ordinary room terrain, corridor, doors, passwall, digging, and liquid destinations, but omits IRONBARS. Because this callback runs after the implemented mfndpos has already selected the square, refusing every bar square here suppresses the source's later postmov behavior. The source filter and action remain intact; this is a missing preflight admission case.
scripts/unported-monster-actions.test.mjs passed, npm run lint passed, and node --check js/unported_monster_actions.js passed.
The corrected tree strictly matches the admitted C recording: 545/545 screens, 545/545 cursors, and 3084/3084 RNG calls. The synthetic range verifier confirms segment 0 through step 544.
